defaults.name: ScaleDown: Extract-1
defaults.description: ScaleDown Extract-1 is a task-specific language model for extracting structured data from unstructured text using a custom JSON schema. It identifies domain-specific entities with confidence scores, character offsets, and surrounding context, and supports nested objects and arrays for workflows such as invoice processing, contract analysis, and record parsing.
